name: Ira
source:
Armed with scythes embedded on his forearms, Ira is a a slim muscular male with predatory, slanted red eyes. Although he specializes in Chinese martial arts, he knows of several other hand to hand combat techniques.
[spoiler]Being an apostle of Index and a subordinate of [url=https://vndb.org/c3156]Georgius of the Rainbow[/url], he fought with the other members of the Punishment Squad against Liselotte in the past; and although he perished, Ira was revived afterwards by [url=https://vndb.org/c3152]Misao[/url] using a artificial body.
His Index name is "Sebastianus of the Holy Bone".[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://11eyes.fandom.com/wiki/Ira]11eyes wiki[/url]]
